tickerText: [TENNIS] Thursday at Almaty: Tsitsipas cruises past Kukushkin 6-1, 6-2, Mannarino upsets Rublev 6-4, 3-6, 6-3 and Duckworth topples Darderi 7-5, 7-6(7) in the round of 16 while Brussels quarterfinalists include Cerundolo, Griekspoor, Struff and Goffin; WTA Osaka sends Ann Li and Katie Boulter through as Ningbo opens with Paolini–Jovic and Kudermetova–Rybakina on deck • [SQUASH] PSA Gold Silicon Valley Open quarterfinals Thursday at Squash Zone after Anahat Singh stuns eight-time world champion Nour El Sherbini 11-8, 11-8, 11-7 and Malaysians Sivasangari and Rachel Arnold set an all-Malaysian quarterfinal; Diego Elias, Mohamed ElShorbagy and top seeds headline the 5:30 PM glass-court session on SquashTV • [BADMINTON] YONEX French Open day three at Arena Grand Paris opens round of 16 with An Se-young vs Tanvi Sharma and Christo Popov vs Rasmus Gemke after Ng Ka Long Angus ousted No. 2 Anders Antonsen 21-18, 21-19 and Alex Lanier fed off the home crowd to beat Jason Gunawan • [PICKLEBALL] Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam round of 16 Thursday at Kai Tak Arena: every seed won on day three as Ben Johns and Anna Leigh Waters debuted with an 11-3, 11-3 mixed win and Nok Yiu Tang faces doubles partner Chao Yi Wang in singles after locals Tang and Hong Kit Wong reached the last 16 • [TABLE TENNIS] ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships in Tashkent hit men’s and women’s team semifinals at 10:00—China vs Chinese Taipei and Korea vs Japan in the men’s draw, China vs Korea and Chinese Taipei vs Japan in the women’s—with team finals and mixed doubles round of 16 on the Thursday slate at Olympic Town

newsItems.title: Ng Ka Long Topples Antonsen
newsItems.excerpt: Hong Kong’s Ng Ka Long Angus beat second seed Anders Antonsen 21-18, 21-19 in the YONEX French Open round of 32, using longer rallies to blunt the Dane after back-to-back finals weeks and advance to face Alwi Farhan.

newsItems.title: Tashkent Team Semifinals
newsItems.excerpt: The 29th ITTF-ATTU Asian Championships in Tashkent move to men’s and women’s team semifinals on Thursday—China vs Chinese Taipei and Korea vs Japan among the 10:00 ties—with women’s and men’s team finals and mixed doubles round of 16 later in the day.

newsItems.title: Mannarino Stuns Rublev
newsItems.excerpt: Adrian Mannarino rallied past fourth seed Andrey Rublev 6-4, 3-6, 6-3 in ATP Almaty’s round of 16 as Stefanos Tsitsipas, James Duckworth and Nikoloz Basilashvili also advanced; Brussels quarterfinal wins went to Francisco Cerundolo, Tallon Griekspoor and Jan-Lennard Struff.

newsItems.title: Seeds Sweep at Kai Tak
newsItems.excerpt: Round of 16 day at the Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam saw every seeded player win, with Ben Johns and Anna Leigh Waters cruising 11-3, 11-3 in mixed doubles on their Hong Kong debuts as Nok Yiu Tang prepares to face doubles partner Chao Yi Wang in women’s singles.
